_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. RPO et Total Orders (visibilite CA futur) en premier, segments OFSE/IET ensuite (3 ans car restructure 2022), New Energy en niche.

kpis.signal: Carnet record $33.5 Mds en 2023 puis $33.1 Mds en 2024, visibilite CA multi-annee. ~91% du RPO sur IET (LNG, new energy).
kpis.description_fr: Remaining Performance Obligations : commandes non encore livrees, principal indicateur de visibilite revenu futur. OFSE $3.0 Mds + IET $30.1 Mds fin 2024.
kpis.description_en: Remaining Performance Obligations: undelivered orders, key forward revenue visibility metric. Year-end 2024: OFSE $3.0B + IET $30.1B.

kpis.signal: Decelaration vs pic 2023 ($30.5 Mds). OFSE $15.2 Mds (-6.7%), IET $13.0 Mds (-8.5%) en 2024.
kpis.description_fr: Commandes totales recues, indicateur avance du CA T+1 a T+3. OFSE pondere par cycle upstream petrolier, IET porte par capex LNG + transition.
kpis.description_en: Total annual orders, leading indicator of T+1 to T+3 revenue. OFSE weighted by upstream oil capex cycle, IET driven by LNG capex + transition.

kpis.signal: Croissance moderee en 2024 (+2%), portee par Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems (+$520M), marge op 12.7% FY24.
kpis.description_fr: Segment OFSE : equipement + services pour exploration / production petroliere (Well Construction, Completions, Production Solutions, Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems). Segmentation BKR depuis FY22 (avant : OFS/OFE separes).
kpis.description_en: OFSE segment: equipment + services for oil exploration / production. Current segmentation since FY22 (previously OFS/OFE separate).

kpis.signal: Segment moteur 2024 (+20%), porte par Gas Technology Equipment (LNG). Marge op 15.0% FY24 (vs 12.9% FY23).
kpis.description_fr: Segment IET : technologies gaz / industrie (Gas Tech Equipment, Gas Tech Services, Industrial Tech, Climate Technology Solutions). Pilier transition energetique BKR (LNG, hydrogen, CCUS).
kpis.description_en: IET segment: gas / industrial technologies (Gas Tech Equipment, Gas Tech Services, Industrial Tech, Climate Technology Solutions). BKR energy-transition pillar.

kpis.signal: Franchi $1 Mds en 2024 (vs $0.4 Mds en 2022). CTS = Climate Technology Solutions.
kpis.description_fr: Commandes New Energy via CTS (Climate Technology Solutions) : hydrogen, CCUS, geothermie, ammoniaque. Indicateur lead-time de la transition energetique BKR.
kpis.description_en: New Energy orders via CTS (Climate Technology Solutions): hydrogen, CCUS, geothermal, ammonia. Lead-time indicator of BKR energy transition.
